ENGLISH LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only an action
   B. A person, place, thing, or idea
   C. Only a describing word
   D. Only a joining word

2. When practising Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing.

3. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.

4. When practising Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.

5. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. Where is the library
   D. Where is the Library

6. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.

7. When practising Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing.

8. When practising Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.

9. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Only one word repeated
   B. No full stops
   C. One main idea with supporting sentences
   D. Many unrelated topics with no link

10. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. run
   C. happiness
   D. blue

11. When practising Pronunciation and Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pronunciation and Listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Pronunciation and Listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Pronunciation and Listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Pronunciation and Listening.

12. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. goed
   C. went
   D. goes

13. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.

14. When practising Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes.

15. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 3.2.1 Intensive Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Correlative Conjunctions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 3.4.1 Mechanics of Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Pronunciation and Vocabulary and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 4.2.1 Intensive Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
